판단 로직은 원본 ACACT Guard(core.py)를 C++로 옮긴:
The decision logic is the original ACACT Guard (core.py) ported to C++; every build compares its decisions with the original simulator automatically.

Closing the GCS puts vehicles the guard was flying into HOLD. If the GCS stops abnormally the velocity commands stop and PX4 enters its offboard-loss failsafe (Hold after COM_OF_LOSS_T) — set the PX4 parameters as in the original set_params.py.

Before field flights always check in SITL, then in a rehearsal with altitude separation.
